<thought>From the 13C NMR data, low-field signals (≈10‑30 ppm) correspond to methyl carbons. The spectrum shows peaks at 26.90 ppm (appearing twice, indicating two equivalent methyl carbons) and 26.18 ppm (one methyl carbon). No other peaks fall in the typical methyl region. Therefore the molecule contains three CH₃ groups.</thought>
<final_answer>3</final_answer>
